Test Title: Verify login with standard valid credentials
Preconditions: User is on login page (https://www.saucedemo.com/)
Test Steps:
1. Enter 'standard_user' into Username field.
2. Enter 'secret_sauce' into Password field.
3. Click 'Login' button.
Expected Result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to Inventory page ('/inventory.html'). Products list is displayed.

Test Title: Verify login failure with locked-out user credentials
Preconditions: User is on login page
Test Steps:
1. Enter 'locked_out_user' into Username field.
2. Enter 'secret_sauce' into Password field.
3. Click 'Login' button.
Expected Result: Error message displayed: 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.' User remains on login page.

Test Title: Verify login failure with invalid password
Preconditions: User is on login page

Expected Result: Error message displayed: 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service'.
